Lemma
[Uniform upper bound for the normalized maximum scalar curvature integral] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0229 1. Lemma 6.60\group normalized-ricci-flow

Along the normalized flow, the time integral of the maximal scalar curvature is bounded above by a constant multiple of the normalized time.
